```diff
+ const API_BASE = 'http://localhost:3000/webhook';

+ // Load tests on page load

+ // Handle form submission
+ async function handleFormSubmit(e) {
+     e.preventDefault();
+     
+     const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
+     const submitText = document.getElementById('submitText');
+     const submitSpinner = document.getElementById('submitSpinner');
+     const formMessage = document.getElementById('formMessage');
+     
+     // Disable button and show spinner
+     submitBtn.disabled = true;
+     submitText.textContent = 'Creating Test...';
+     submitSpinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
+     formMessage.style.display = 'none';
+     
+     try {
+         const formData = new FormData(e.target);
+         const phone_number = formData.get('phone_number');
+         const scenario = formData.get('scenario');
+         const final_outcome_text = formData.get('final_outcome');
+         
+         // Parse final_outcome if provided
+         let final_outcome = null;
+         if (final_outcome_text &amp;&amp; final_outcome_text.trim()) {
+             try {
+                 final_outcome = JSON.parse(final_outcome_text);
+             } catch (err) {
+                 throw new Error('Invalid JSON in Expected Outcome field');
+             }
+         }
+         
+         const response = await fetch(&#96;${API_BASE}/test/run&#96;, {
+             method: 'POST',
+             headers: {
+                 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+             },
+             body: JSON.stringify({
+                 phone_number,
+                 scenario,
+                 final_outcome
+             })
+         });
+         
+         const data = await response.json();
+         
+         if (!response.ok) {
+             throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to create test');
+         }
+         
+         // Show success message
+         formMessage.className = 'message success';
+         formMessage.textContent = &#96;Test created successfully! Test ID: ${data.testId}&#96;;
+         formMessage.style.display = 'block';
+         
+         // Reset form
+         e.target.reset();
+         
+         // Reload tests list
+         setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+             loadTests();
+         }, 1000);
+         
+     } catch (error) {
+         formMessage.className = 'message error';
+         formMessage.textContent = &#96;Error: ${error.message}&#96;;
+         formMessage.style.display = 'block';
+     } finally {
+         // Re-enable button
+         submitBtn.disabled = false;
+         submitText.textContent = 'Run Test';
+         submitSpinner.style.display = 'none';
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ // Load all tests
+ async function loadTests() {
+     const testsList = document.getElementById('testsList');
+     testsList.innerHTML = '&lt;div class="loading"&gt;Loading tests...&lt;/div&gt;';
+     
+     try {
+         const response = await fetch(&#96;${API_BASE}/tests&#96;);
+         const data = await response.json();
+         
+         if (!response.ok) {
+             throw new Error(data.message || 'Failed to load tests');
+         }
+         
+         if (data.tests &amp;&amp; data.tests.length === 0) {
+             testsList.innerHTML = '&lt;div class="loading"&gt;No tests found. Create your first test above!&lt;/div&gt;';
+             return;
+         }
+         
+         testsList.innerHTML = data.tests.map(test =&gt; createTestCard(test)).join('');
+         
+         // Add click handlers
+         document.querySelectorAll('.test-card').forEach(card =&gt; {
+             card.addEventListener('click', () =&gt; {
+                 const testId = card.dataset.testId;

+     } catch (error) {

+     }
+ }

+                     &lt;div class="evaluation-metric-score"&gt;${evaluation.compliance.score || 0}/100&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="evaluation-metric-reasoning"&gt;${evaluation.compliance.reasoning || ''}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &#96; : ''}
+                 
+                 ${evaluation.security ? &#96;
+                 &lt;div class="evaluation-metric"&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="evaluation-metric-label"&gt;Security&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="evaluation-metric-score"&gt;${evaluation.security.score || 0}/100&lt;/div&gt;
+                     &lt;div class="evaluation-metric-reasoning"&gt;${evaluation.security.reasoning || ''}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+                 &#96; : ''}

+             &lt;div class="detail-item" style="margin-top: 20px;"&gt;
+                 &lt;span class="detail-label"&gt;Summary&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="detail-value"&gt;${escapeHtml(evaluation.summary)}&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &#96; : ''}

+                 &lt;div class="detail-value"&gt;

+                         ${evaluation.keyIssues.map(issue =&gt; &#96;&lt;li&gt;${escapeHtml(issue)}&lt;/li&gt;&#96;).join('')}
+                     &lt;/ul&gt;
+                 &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &#96; : ''}
+             
+             ${evaluation.recommendations &amp;&amp; evaluation.recommendations.length &gt; 0 ? &#96;
+             &lt;div class="detail-item" style="margin-top: 20px;"&gt;
+                 &lt;span class="detail-label"&gt;Recommendations&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="detail-value"&gt;

+                     &lt;/ul&gt;

+             &lt;/div&gt;

+                 &lt;span class="detail-label"&gt;Sentiment&lt;/span&gt;
+                 &lt;div class="detail-value"&gt;${evaluation.sentiment.value || 'N/A'} (${evaluation.sentiment.confidence || 0}% confidence)&lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+             &#96; : ''}
+         &lt;/div&gt;

+         &lt;div class="detail-section"&gt;
+             &lt;h3&gt;Full Evaluation JSON&lt;/h3&gt;
+             &lt;div class="detail-item"&gt;

+             &lt;/div&gt;

+ // Close modal
+ function closeModal() {
+     document.getElementById('testModal').style.display = 'none';
+ }
+ 
+ // Close modal when clicking outside
+ document.getElementById('testModal')?.addEventListener('click', (e) =&gt; {
+     if (e.target.id === 'testModal') {
+         closeModal();
+     }
+ });
+ 
+ // Utility functions
+ function escapeHtml(text) {
+     const div = document.createElement('div');
+     div.textContent = text;
+     return div.innerHTML;
+ }
+ 
+ function formatJSON(obj) {
+     if (obj === null || obj === undefined) {
+         return 'null';
+     }
+     
+     try {
+         const jsonString = JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
+         return syntaxHighlight(jsonString);
+     } catch (e) {
+         return escapeHtml(String(obj));
+     }
+ }
+ 
+ function syntaxHighlight(json) {
+     json = json.replace(/&amp;/g, '&amp;amp;').replace(/&lt;/g, '&amp;lt;').replace(/&gt;/g, '&amp;gt;');
+     return json.replace(/("(\\u[a-zA-Z0-9]{4}|\\[^u]|[^\\"])*"(\s*:)?|\b(true|false|null)\b|-?\d+(?:\.\d*)?(?:[eE][+\-]?\d+)?)/g, function (match) {
+         let cls = 'json-number';
+         if (/^"/.test(match)) {
+             if (/:$/.test(match)) {
+                 cls = 'json-key';
+             } else {
+                 cls = 'json-string';
+             }
+         } else if (/true|false/.test(match)) {
+             cls = 'json-boolean';
+         } else if (/null/.test(match)) {
+             cls = 'json-null';
+         }
+         return '&lt;span class="' + cls + '"&gt;' + match + '&lt;/span&gt;';
+     });
+ }
+
```

## Frontend dashboard created

### Features

1. **Dashboard form** (`/public/index.html`)
   - Form to submit test runs to `/webhook/test/run`
   - Fields: Phone Number, Scenario, Expected Outcome (JSON)
   - "Load Example" button to pre-fill with your example data
   - Success/error messages

2. **Test list view**
   - Displays all tests with test IDs
   - Shows status, score, phone number, and creation date
   - Clickable cards to view details
   - Auto-refreshes after creating a new test

3. **Test detail modal**
   - Opens when clicking a test card
   - Automatically fetches recordings if test is not evaluated
   - Shows:
     - Test information (ID, status, score, cost, duration)
     - Scenario and expected outcome
     - Transcript (if available)
     - Audio recording player (if available)
     - **Evaluation results** with:
       - Overall score and pass/fail status
       - Individual metric scores (Task Completion, Accuracy, Naturalness, Empathy, etc.)
       - Summary, key issues, and recommendations
       - **Full evaluation JSON** in a syntax-highlighted viewer

4. **Styling**
   - Responsive layout
   - Color-coded status indicators
   - JSON syntax highlighting
   - Audio player for recordings

### How to use

1. Start your server:
   ```bash
   npm start
   ```

2. Open your browser to:
   ```
   http://localhost:3000
   ```

3. Create a test:
   - Click "Load Example" to pre-fill the form
   - Or manually enter test data
   - Click "Run Test"

4. View results:
   - Tests appear in the "Test History" section
   - Click any test card to view details
   - The evaluation JSON is displayed in the "Full Evaluation JSON" section

The frontend automatically:
- Fetches call recordings when you click on a test that hasn't been evaluated
- Displays all evaluation metrics in an organized grid
- Shows the complete evaluation JSON with syntax highlighting

The dashboard is ready to use.

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,35 @@
- 
+ # Use Node.js LTS version
+ FROM node:20-slim
+ 
+ # Install build dependencies for better-sqlite3
+ RUN apt-get update &amp;&amp; apt-get install -y \
+     python3 \
+     make \
+     g++ \
+     &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+ 
+ # Set working directory
+ WORKDIR /app
+ 
+ # Copy package files
+ COPY package*.json ./
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ RUN npm ci --only=production
+ 
+ # Copy application files
+ COPY . .
+ 
+ # Create directory for database
+ RUN mkdir -p database &amp;&amp; chmod 755 database
+ 
+ # Expose port
+ EXPOSE 3000
+ 
+ # Health check
+ HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
+   CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3000/', (r) =&gt; {process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1)})"
+ 
+ # Start application
+ CMD ["node", "index.js"]
+ 
```

</details>

```diff
+ # Nginx configuration for DigitalOcean Droplet
+ # Place this file at /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto
+ 
+ server {
+     listen 80;
+     server_name your-domain.com www.your-domain.com;
+ 
+     # Redirect HTTP to HTTPS (uncomment after setting up SSL)
+     # return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
+ 
+     # For now, proxy to Node.js app
+     location / {
+         proxy_pass http://localhost:3000;
+         proxy_http_version 1.1;
+         proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
+         proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade';
+         proxy_set_header Host $host;
+         proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
+         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
+         proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
+         proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade;
+     }
+ 
+     # Increase timeouts for long-running requests
+     proxy_connect_timeout 300s;
+     proxy_send_timeout 300s;
+     proxy_read_timeout 300s;
+ }
```

```diff
- 
+ #!/bin/bash
+ 
+ # Deployment script for DigitalOcean Droplet
+ # Run this script on your server after initial setup
+ 
+ set -e
+ 
+ echo "🚀 Starting deployment..."
+ 
+ # Navigate to app directory
+ cd /var/www/superbryn-proto || exit
+ 
+ # Pull latest changes
+ echo "📥 Pulling latest changes..."
+ git pull origin main
+ 
+ # Install/update dependencies
+ echo "📦 Installing dependencies..."
+ npm ci --only=production
+ 
+ # Create logs directory if it doesn't exist
+ mkdir -p logs
+ 
+ # Restart application with PM2
+ echo "🔄 Restarting application..."
+ pm2 restart ecosystem.config.js || pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+ 
+ # Save PM2 process list
+ pm2 save
+ 
+ echo "✅ Deployment complete!"
+ echo "📊 Check status with: pm2 status"
+ echo "📝 View logs with: pm2 logs superbryn-proto"
+ 
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,302 @@
- 
+ # Deployment Guide - DigitalOcean
+ 
+ This guide covers deploying the Voice Agent Testing Dashboard on DigitalOcean with budget-friendly options.
+ 
+ ## 💰 Cost Comparison
+ 
+ | Option | Monthly Cost | Setup Difficulty | Best For |
+ |--------|--------------|-------------------|----------|
+ | **DigitalOcean Droplet** | $4-6/month | Medium | Production, full control |
+ | **DigitalOcean App Platform** | $5-12/month | Easy | Quick deployment, auto-scaling |
+ | **Railway/Render** | $5-7/month | Very Easy | Development, quick testing |
+ 
+ ## 🎯 Recommended: DigitalOcean Droplet ($4-6/month)
+ 
+ ### Prerequisites
+ - DigitalOcean account
+ - Domain name (optional, can use IP address)
+ - GitHub repository with your code
+ 
+ ### Step 1: Create Droplet
+ 
+ 1. Go to [DigitalOcean](https://www.digitalocean.com/)
+ 2. Click **Create** → **Droplets**
+ 3. Choose:
+    - **Image**: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
+    - **Plan**: Basic - Regular Intel with SSD ($4/month - 512MB RAM) or ($6/month - 1GB RAM recommended)
+    - **Datacenter**: Choose closest to your users
+    - **Authentication**: SSH keys (recommended) or password
+ 4. Click **Create Droplet**
+ 
+ ### Step 2: Initial Server Setup
+ 
+ SSH into your droplet:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ ssh root@your-droplet-ip
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ #### Update system and install Node.js
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Update system
+ apt update &amp;&amp; apt upgrade -y
+ 
+ # Install Node.js 20.x
+ curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash -
+ apt install -y nodejs
+ 
+ # Verify installation
+ node --version
+ npm --version
+ 
+ # Install PM2 globally (process manager)
+ npm install -g pm2
+ 
+ # Install Nginx (reverse proxy)
+ apt install -y nginx
+ 
+ # Install Git
+ apt install -y git
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 3: Clone and Setup Application
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Create app directory
+ mkdir -p /var/www
+ cd /var/www
+ 
+ # Clone your repository
+ git clone https://github.com/your-username/superbryn-proto.git
+ cd superbryn-proto
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ npm ci --only=production
+ 
+ # Create logs directory
+ mkdir -p logs
+ 
+ # Create .env file
+ nano .env
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Add your environment variables:
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;env
+ PORT=3000
+ NODE_ENV=production
+ VAPI_API_KEY=your_vapi_api_key
+ VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=your_phone_number_id
+ WEBHOOK_URL=https://your-domain.com/webhook
+ GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Save and exit (Ctrl+X, Y, Enter)
+ 
+ ### Step 4: Start Application with PM2
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Start application
+ pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+ 
+ # Save PM2 configuration
+ pm2 save
+ 
+ # Setup PM2 to start on boot
+ pm2 startup
+ # Follow the instructions shown
+ 
+ # Check status
+ pm2 status
+ pm2 logs superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 5: Configure Nginx
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Copy nginx config
+ cp nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto
+ 
+ # Edit the config
+ nano /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Update &#96;your-domain.com&#96; with your actual domain or remove server_name line if using IP.
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Enable site
+ ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
+ 
+ # Remove default site (optional)
+ rm /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
+ 
+ # Test nginx config
+ nginx -t
+ 
+ # Restart nginx
+ systemctl restart nginx
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 6: Setup Firewall
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Allow SSH, HTTP, HTTPS
+ ufw allow OpenSSH
+ ufw allow 'Nginx Full'
+ ufw enable
+ 
+ # Check status
+ ufw status
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 7: Setup SSL (Optional but Recommended)
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install Certbot
+ apt install -y certbot python3-certbot-nginx
+ 
+ # Get SSL certificate (replace with your domain)
+ certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com -d www.your-domain.com
+ 
+ # Auto-renewal is set up automatically
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 8: Setup Auto-Deployment (Optional)
+ 
+ Create a GitHub Actions workflow or use the deploy script:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Make deploy script executable
+ chmod +x deploy.sh
+ 
+ # Run deployment
+ ./deploy.sh
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🚀 Alternative: DigitalOcean App Platform ($5-12/month)
+ 
+ ### Step 1: Create App
+ 
+ 1. Go to DigitalOcean → **App Platform**
+ 2. Click **Create App**
+ 3. Connect your GitHub repository
+ 4. Select the repository and branch
+ 
+ ### Step 2: Configure Build Settings
+ 
+ - **Build Command**: &#96;npm ci --only=production&#96;
+ - **Run Command**: &#96;node index.js&#96;
+ - **HTTP Port**: &#96;3000&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 3: Add Environment Variables
+ 
+ Add all variables from &#96;.env.example&#96;:
+ - &#96;VAPI_API_KEY&#96;
+ - &#96;VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID&#96;
+ - &#96;WEBHOOK_URL&#96;
+ - &#96;GEMINI_API_KEY&#96;
+ - &#96;NODE_ENV=production&#96;
+ - &#96;PORT=3000&#96;
+ 
+ ### Step 4: Deploy
+ 
+ Click **Deploy** and wait for deployment to complete.
+ 
+ ## 📊 Monitoring &amp; Maintenance
+ 
+ ### Check Application Status
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pm2 status
+ pm2 logs superbryn-proto
+ pm2 monit
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Restart Application
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pm2 restart superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Update Application
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd /var/www/superbryn-proto
+ git pull
+ npm ci --only=production
+ pm2 restart superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Backup Database
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Create backup
+ cp database/database.sqlite database/database.sqlite.backup
+ 
+ # Or use cron for automatic backups
+ crontab -e
+ # Add: 0 2 * * * cp /var/www/superbryn-proto/database/database.sqlite /var/www/superbryn-proto/database/database.sqlite.backup.$(date +\%Y\%m\%d)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 🔧 Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### Application won't start
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check logs
+ pm2 logs superbryn-proto --lines 50
+ 
+ # Check if port is in use
+ netstat -tulpn | grep 3000
+ 
+ # Check environment variables
+ pm2 env 0
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Nginx errors
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check nginx logs
+ tail -f /var/log/nginx/error.log
+ 
+ # Test nginx config
+ nginx -t
+ 
+ # Restart nginx
+ systemctl restart nginx
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Database issues
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check database file permissions
+ ls -la database/
+ 
+ # Fix permissions if needed
+ chmod 644 database/database.sqlite
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 💡 Cost Optimization Tips
+ 
+ 1. **Use smallest droplet** ($4/month) if traffic is low
+ 2. **Monitor usage** with DigitalOcean monitoring
+ 3. **Use Cloudflare** (free) for CDN and DDoS protection
+ 4. **Enable DO Spaces** ($5/month) for file storage if needed
+ 5. **Use Let's Encrypt** (free SSL certificates)
+ 
+ ## 🔒 Security Checklist
+ 
+ - [ ] Change default SSH port (optional)
+ - [ ] Setup firewall (UFW)
+ - [ ] Use SSH keys instead of passwords
+ - [ ] Enable SSL/HTTPS
+ - [ ] Keep system updated: &#96;apt update &amp;&amp; apt upgrade&#96;
+ - [ ] Use strong environment variable values
+ - [ ] Regular backups of database
+ - [ ] Monitor logs for suspicious activity
+ 
+ ## 📞 Support
+ 
+ - **DigitalOcean Docs**: https://docs.digitalocean.com/
+ - **PM2 Docs**: https://pm2.keymetrics.io/
+ - **Nginx Docs**: https://nginx.org/en/docs/
+ 
+ ## 🎉 You're Done!
+ 
+ Your application should now be accessible at:
+ - &#96;http://your-droplet-ip&#96; (if using IP)
+ - &#96;https://your-domain.com&#96; (if using domain)
+ 
+ Visit the URL in your browser to see your dashboard!
+
```

```diff
+ #!/bin/bash
+ 
+ # Server setup script for DigitalOcean Droplet
+ # Run this as root on a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 droplet
+ 
+ set -e
+ 
+ echo "🚀 Starting server setup..."
+ 
+ # Update system
+ echo "📦 Updating system packages..."
+ apt update &amp;&amp; apt upgrade -y
+ 
+ # Install Node.js 20.x
+ echo "📦 Installing Node.js 20.x..."
+ curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash -
+ apt install -y nodejs
+ 
+ # Install PM2 globally
+ echo "📦 Installing PM2..."
+ npm install -g pm2
+ 
+ # Install Nginx
+ echo "📦 Installing Nginx..."
+ apt install -y nginx
+ 
+ # Install Git
+ echo "📦 Installing Git..."
+ apt install -y git
+ 
+ # Install build tools for better-sqlite3
+ echo "📦 Installing build dependencies..."
+ apt install -y python3 make g++
+ 
+ # Setup firewall
+ echo "🔥 Configuring firewall..."
+ ufw allow OpenSSH
+ ufw allow 'Nginx Full'
+ ufw --force enable
+ 
+ # Create app directory
+ echo "📁 Creating app directory..."
+ mkdir -p /var/www
+ 
+ # Display versions
+ echo ""
+ echo "✅ Setup complete!"
+ echo ""
+ echo "Installed versions:"
+ echo "Node.js: $(node --version)"
+ echo "npm: $(npm --version)"
+ echo "PM2: $(pm2 --version)"
+ echo ""
+ echo "Next steps:"
+ echo "1. Clone your repository: cd /var/www &amp;&amp; git clone &lt;your-repo-url&gt;"
+ echo "2. Navigate to app: cd /var/www/superbryn-proto"
+ echo "3. Install dependencies: npm ci --only=production"
+ echo "4. Setup .env file: cp env.example .env &amp;&amp; nano .env"
+ echo "5. Start app: pm2 start ecosystem.config.js &amp;&amp; pm2 save &amp;&amp; pm2 startup"
+ echo "6. Setup Nginx: cp nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto"
+ echo "7. Enable site: ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/"
+ echo "8. Restart Nginx: systemctl restart nginx"
+ 
```

```diff
- 
+ # 🔒 Voice Agent Testing Dashboard
+ 
+ A comprehensive dashboard for testing and evaluating voice AI agents with security testing capabilities.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - 📞 **Test Voice Agents**: Create and run test scenarios against voice AI agents
+ - 📊 **Real-time Evaluation**: Automatic evaluation of agent performance using AI
+ - 🎯 **Security Testing**: Built-in security test scenarios and evaluation
+ - 📈 **Dashboard UI**: Beautiful, modern dashboard to view test results
+ - 💾 **Test History**: Track all tests with detailed results and transcripts
+ - 🎵 **Audio Recordings**: Listen to call recordings directly in the dashboard
+ 
+ ## Quick Start
+ 
+ ### Local Development
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install dependencies
+ npm install
+ 
+ # Copy environment file
+ cp env.example .env
+ 
+ # Edit .env with your API keys
+ nano .env
+ 
+ # Start development server
+ npm run dev
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Visit &#96;http://localhost:3000&#96; to see the dashboard.
+ 
+ ## Deployment
+ 
+ ### 🚀 Quick Deploy Options
+ 
+ **Budget-Friendly Hosting ($4-12/month):**
+ 
+ 1. **DigitalOcean Droplet** ($4-6/month) - [Full Guide](DEPLOYMENT.md)
+ 2. **DigitalOcean App Platform** ($5-12/month) - [Quick Start](QUICK_START.md)
+ 3. **Railway.app** ($5/month) - [Quick Start](QUICK_START.md)
+ 4. **Render.com** ($7/month) - [Quick Start](QUICK_START.md)
+ 
+ ### Recommended: DigitalOcean Droplet
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # On your fresh Ubuntu 22.04 droplet
+ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/your-repo/setup-server.sh | bash
+ 
+ # Or follow the detailed guide
+ # See DEPLOYMENT.md for complete instructions
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Environment Variables
+ 
+ Required environment variables (see &#96;env.example&#96;):
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;env
+ PORT=3000
+ NODE_ENV=production
+ VAPI_API_KEY=your_vapi_api_key
+ VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=your_phone_number_id
+ WEBHOOK_URL=https://your-domain.com/webhook
+ GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Project Structure
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ superbryn-proto/
+ ├── public/              # Frontend files (HTML, CSS, JS)
+ ├── routes/              # API routes
+ ├── services/            # Business logic (evaluator, prompt builder)
+ ├── database/            # SQLite database and queries
+ ├── test-cases/          # Test case examples
+ ├── vapi-agent-config/   # Agent configuration files
+ ├── Dockerfile           # Docker configuration
+ ├── ecosystem.config.js  # PM2 configuration
+ ├── nginx.conf          # Nginx reverse proxy config
+ └── deploy.sh           # Deployment script
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## API Endpoints
+ 
+ - &#96;POST /webhook/test/run&#96; - Create and run a new test
+ - &#96;GET /webhook/tests&#96; - Get all tests
+ - &#96;GET /webhook/tests/:id&#96; - Get single test details
+ - &#96;POST /webhook/get-call-recordings&#96; - Fetch and evaluate call recordings
+ 
+ ## Technology Stack
+ 
+ - **Backend**: Node.js, Express.js
+ - **Database**: SQLite (better-sqlite3)
+ - **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript
+ - **APIs**: VAPI, Google Gemini
+ - **Process Manager**: PM2
+ - **Web Server**: Nginx
+ 
+ ## Development
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Install dependencies
+ npm install
+ 
+ # Run development server
+ npm run dev
+ 
+ # Production start
+ npm start
+ 
+ # PM2 management
+ npm run pm2:start
+ npm run pm2:restart
+ npm run pm2:stop
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Documentation
+ 
+ - [Deployment Guide](DEPLOYMENT.md) - Complete deployment instructions
+ - [Quick Start](QUICK_START.md) - Fast deployment options
+ - [Test Cases](test-cases/) - Example test scenarios
+ 
+ ## Cost Breakdown
+ 
+ | Component | Monthly Cost |
+ |-----------|--------------|
+ | DigitalOcean Droplet (1GB) | $6 |
+ | Domain (optional) | $0-15 |
+ | SSL Certificate | Free (Let's Encrypt) |
+ | **Total** | **$6-21/month** |
+ 
+ ## Security
+ 
+ - Environment variables for sensitive data
+ - SQLite database with proper file permissions
+ - Nginx reverse proxy with SSL support
+ - Firewall configuration (UFW)
+ - PM2 process management for reliability
+ 
+ ## License
+ 
+ ISC
+ 
+ ## Support
+ 
+ For deployment issues, see:
+ - [DEPLOYMENT.md](DEPLOYMENT.md) - Detailed deployment guide
+ - [QUICK_START.md](QUICK_START.md) - Quick deployment options
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ **Made with ❤️ for testing voice AI agents**
+
```

```diff
- 
+ # 🚀 Deployment Summary - Budget-Friendly Hosting
+ 
+ ## 💰 Cost Comparison
+ 
+ | Platform | Monthly Cost | Setup Time | Best For |
+ |----------|--------------|------------|----------|
+ | **DigitalOcean Droplet** | **$4-6** | 15 min | Production, full control |
+ | DigitalOcean App Platform | $5-12 | 5 min | Quick deploy, auto-scaling |
+ | Railway.app | $5 | 5 min | Development, testing |
+ | Render.com | $7 | 5 min | Simple deployments |
+ 
+ ## 🎯 Recommended: DigitalOcean Droplet ($4-6/month)
+ 
+ ### Why DigitalOcean Droplet?
+ 
+ ✅ **Lowest Cost**: $4/month for 512MB RAM, $6/month for 1GB  
+ ✅ **Full Control**: Complete server access  
+ ✅ **Scalable**: Easy to upgrade when needed  
+ ✅ **Reliable**: Industry-standard infrastructure  
+ ✅ **Free SSL**: Let's Encrypt certificates  
+ 
+ ### Quick Setup (15 minutes)
+ 
+ 1. **Create Droplet** ($4-6/month)
+    - Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
+    - Basic plan (512MB or 1GB RAM)
+    - Your preferred datacenter
+ 
+ 2. **Run Setup Script**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    ssh root@your-droplet-ip
+    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/your-repo/setup-server.sh | bash
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 3. **Deploy Your App**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cd /var/www
+    git clone https://github.com/your-username/superbryn-proto.git
+    cd superbryn-proto
+    npm ci --only=production
+    cp env.example .env
+    nano .env  # Add your API keys
+    pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
+    pm2 save
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 4. **Setup Nginx**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    cp nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto
+    ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
+    systemctl restart nginx
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 5. **SSL (Optional)**
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+    apt install -y certbot python3-certbot-nginx
+    certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com
+    &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ **Total Cost: $4-6/month** ✅
+ 
+ ## 🚀 Alternative: DigitalOcean App Platform ($5-12/month)
+ 
+ ### Why App Platform?
+ 
+ ✅ **Easiest Setup**: 5-minute deployment  
+ ✅ **Auto-scaling**: Handles traffic spikes  
+ ✅ **Auto-deploy**: GitHub integration  
+ ✅ **Managed**: Less maintenance  
+ 
+ ### Setup (5 minutes)
+ 
+ 1. Go to DigitalOcean → **App Platform**
+ 2. **Create App** → Connect GitHub
+ 3. Select repository
+ 4. Configure:
+    - Build: &#96;npm ci --only=production&#96;
+    - Run: &#96;node index.js&#96;
+    - Port: &#96;3000&#96;
+ 5. Add environment variables
+ 6. Deploy!
+ 
+ **Total Cost: $5-12/month** ✅
+ 
+ ## 📋 What You Need
+ 
+ ### Required API Keys
+ 
+ 1. **VAPI API Key** - From [VAPI Dashboard](https://dashboard.vapi.ai)
+ 2. **VAPI Phone Number ID** - From VAPI Dashboard
+ 3. **Google Gemini API Key** - From [Google AI Studio](https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey)
+ 4. **Domain Name** (optional) - Can use IP address
+ 
+ ### Environment Variables
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;env
+ VAPI_API_KEY=your_key_here
+ VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=your_id_here
+ WEBHOOK_URL=https://your-domain.com/webhook
+ GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key_here
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📊 Resource Requirements
+ 
+ ### Minimum Requirements
+ 
+ - **RAM**: 512MB (1GB recommended)
+ - **CPU**: 1 vCPU
+ - **Storage**: 10GB SSD
+ - **Bandwidth**: 1TB/month
+ 
+ ### Recommended Droplet Size
+ 
+ - **$4/month**: 512MB RAM - Good for testing
+ - **$6/month**: 1GB RAM - Recommended for production
+ - **$12/month**: 2GB RAM - For high traffic
+ 
+ ## 🔧 Maintenance
+ 
+ ### Daily Operations
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Check app status
+ pm2 status
+ 
+ # View logs
+ pm2 logs superbryn-proto
+ 
+ # Restart app
+ pm2 restart superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Updates
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ cd /var/www/superbryn-proto
+ git pull
+ npm ci --only=production
+ pm2 restart superbryn-proto
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Backups
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Backup database
+ cp database/database.sqlite database/backup-$(date +%Y%m%d).sqlite
+ 
+ # Or setup automatic backups
+ crontab -e
+ # Add: 0 2 * * * cp /var/www/superbryn-proto/database/database.sqlite /var/www/superbryn-proto/database/backup-$(date +\%Y\%m\%d).sqlite
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 💡 Cost Optimization Tips
+ 
+ 1. **Start Small**: Use $4/month droplet, upgrade if needed
+ 2. **Use Free SSL**: Let's Encrypt (included)
+ 3. **Monitor Usage**: DigitalOcean provides free monitoring
+ 4. **Optimize Images**: Use Cloudflare (free CDN)
+ 5. **Database**: SQLite is included (no extra cost)
+ 
+ ## 🆘 Troubleshooting
+ 
+ ### App Won't Start
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pm2 logs superbryn-proto --lines 50
+ # Check for missing environment variables
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### High Memory Usage
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pm2 monit
+ # Consider upgrading to 1GB RAM droplet
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Port Already in Use
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ netstat -tulpn | grep 3000
+ # Kill process or change PORT in .env
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 📈 Scaling
+ 
+ ### When to Upgrade
+ 
+ - **512MB → 1GB**: If app crashes or slow
+ - **1GB → 2GB**: High traffic or multiple apps
+ - **Add Load Balancer**: For multiple instances
+ 
+ ### Upgrade Process
+ 
+ 1. DigitalOcean Dashboard → Droplet → Resize
+ 2. Choose new size
+ 3. Reboot droplet
+ 4. App continues running (PM2 auto-restarts)
+ 
+ ## ✅ Deployment Checklist
+ 
+ - [ ] Created DigitalOcean account
+ - [ ] Created droplet or app
+ - [ ] Cloned repository
+ - [ ] Installed dependencies
+ - [ ] Configured environment variables
+ - [ ] Started application (PM2)
+ - [ ] Configured Nginx
+ - [ ] Setup firewall
+ - [ ] SSL certificate (optional)
+ - [ ] Tested dashboard access
+ - [ ] Setup backups
+ - [ ] Monitored logs
+ 
+ ## 🎉 You're Ready!
+ 
+ Your application is now live at:
+ - &#96;http://your-droplet-ip&#96; (if using IP)
+ - &#96;https://your-domain.com&#96; (if using domain)
+ 
+ **Total Monthly Cost: $4-6** 🎯
+ 
+ ---
+ 
+ For detailed instructions, see:
+ - [DEPLOYMENT.md](DEPLOYMENT.md) - Complete guide
+ - [QUICK_START.md](QUICK_START.md) - Quick reference
+
```

## Deployment files created

### Core deployment files

### Documentation
1. **README.md** — Project overview

4. **DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md** — Cost comparison and recommendations

### Updated files
- **package.json** — Added production scripts

## Recommended: DigitalOcean Droplet ($4-6/month)

### Quick deployment steps

1. Create a DigitalOcean Droplet:
   - Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
   - $4/month (512MB) or $6/month (1GB recommended)
   - Choose your datacenter

2. SSH into your droplet:
   ```bash
   ssh root@your-droplet-ip
   ```

3. Run the setup script:
   ```bash
   # Download and run (or copy setup-server.sh to server)
   bash setup-server.sh
   ```

4. Deploy your app:
   ```bash
   cd /var/www
   git clone https://github.com/your-username/superbryn-proto.git
   cd superbryn-proto
   npm ci --only=production
   cp env.example .env
   nano .env  # Add your API keys
   pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
   pm2 save
   pm2 startup
   ```

5. Configure Nginx:
   ```bash
   cp nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto
   # Edit nginx.conf to update domain name
   ln -s /etc/nginx/sites-available/superbryn-proto /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/
   systemctl restart nginx
   ```

6. Setup SSL (optional):
   ```bash
   apt install -y certbot python3-certbot-nginx
   certbot --nginx -d your-domain.com
   ```

## Cost breakdown

| Item | Cost |
|------|------|
| DigitalOcean Droplet (1GB) | $6/month |
| Domain (optional) | $0-15/year |
| SSL Certificate | Free (Let's Encrypt) |
| Total | $6/month |

## Alternative options

- DigitalOcean App Platform: $5-12/month (5-minute setup)
- Railway.app: $5/month (easy deployment)
- Render.com: $7/month (simple setup)

## Next steps

1. Review `DEPLOYMENT.md` for detailed instructions
2. Check `QUICK_START.md` for quick reference
3. See `DEPLOYMENT_SUMMARY.md` for cost comparison
4. Create your DigitalOcean account and droplet
5. Follow the deployment steps above

All files are ready. The setup is optimized for low cost while maintaining production quality. The $4-6/month DigitalOcean Droplet option is recommended for budget-friendly hosting.

```diff
+ // Webhook endpoint for VAPI callbacks (when call ends)
+ router.post('/test/get-results', async (req, res) =&gt; {
+     try {
+         console.log('VAPI Webhook received:', JSON.stringify(req.body, null, 2));
+         
+         const callData = req.body;
+         const callId = callData.id || callData.callId;
+ 
+         if (!callId) {
+             console.error('No call ID in webhook payload');
+             return res.status(400).json({
+                 message: 'Missing call ID in webhook payload'
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         // Get test by VAPI call ID
+         const { getTestByVapiCallId } = await import('../database/index.js');
+         const test = getTestByVapiCallId(callId);
+ 
+         if (!test) {
+             console.error('Test not found for call ID:', callId);
+             return res.status(404).json({
+                 message: 'Test not found for this call'
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         // If transcript is available in webhook, process it
+         if (callData.transcript &amp;&amp; test.expected_outcome) {
+             try {
+                 const { evaluateTest } = await import('../services/evaluator.js');
+                 let expectedOutcome = test.expected_outcome;
+                 
+                 // Parse expected outcome if it's a string
+                 if (typeof expectedOutcome === 'string') {
+                     try {
+                         expectedOutcome = JSON.parse(expectedOutcome);
+                     } catch (e) {
+                         // Keep as string if parsing fails
+                     }
+                 }
+ 
+                 // Evaluate the test
+                 const evaluation = await evaluateTest(
+                     callData.transcript,
+                     test.scenario,
+                     expectedOutcome
+                 );
+ 
+                 // Update test results
+                 updateTestResults(callId, {
+                     status: 'evaluated',
+                     transcript: callData.transcript,
+                     recordingUrl: callData.recordingUrl || callData.artifact?.recordingUrl || null,
+                     stereoRecordingUrl: callData.stereoRecordingUrl || callData.artifact?.stereoRecordingUrl || null,
+                     durationSeconds: callData.durationSeconds || null,
+                     cost: callData.cost || null,
+                     endedReason: callData.endedReason || null,
+                     rawResponse: callData,
+                     evaluationResults: evaluation,
+                     overallScore: evaluation.overallScore || null,
+                     passed: evaluation.passed || false
+                 });
+ 
+                 console.log('Test evaluated and stored for call:', callId);
+             } catch (evalError) {
+                 console.error('Error evaluating test:', evalError);
+                 // Still update with basic info even if evaluation fails
+                 updateTestResults(callId, {
+                     status: 'completed',
+                     transcript: callData.transcript || null,
+                     recordingUrl: callData.recordingUrl || callData.artifact?.recordingUrl || null,
+                     stereoRecordingUrl: callData.stereoRecordingUrl || callData.artifact?.stereoRecordingUrl || null,
+                     durationSeconds: callData.durationSeconds || null,
+                     cost: callData.cost || null,
+                     endedReason: callData.endedReason || null,
+                     rawResponse: callData
+                 });
+             }
+         } else {
+             // Update with basic call info even without transcript
+             updateTestResults(callId, {
+                 status: 'completed',
+                 transcript: callData.transcript || null,
+                 recordingUrl: callData.recordingUrl || callData.artifact?.recordingUrl || null,
+                 stereoRecordingUrl: callData.stereoRecordingUrl || callData.artifact?.stereoRecordingUrl || null,
+                 durationSeconds: callData.durationSeconds || null,
+                 cost: callData.cost || null,
+                 endedReason: callData.endedReason || null,
+                 rawResponse: callData
+             });
+         }
+ 
+         res.status(200).json({
+             message: 'Webhook received and processed',
+             callId: callId
+         });
+     } catch (error) {
+         console.error('Error processing webhook:', error);
+         res.status(500).json({
+             message: 'Error processing webhook',
+             error: error.message
+         });
+     }
+ });
```
